lines.text: Hello, friends! I am Milo the bluebird.
Today is Animal Champions day!
We will find the tallest, the biggest, and the loudest animals.
Four champions are here. Count them with me. One, two, three, four!
Are you ready to meet the champions? Let's go!
Who is the tallest animal in the whole world?
Is it the elephant? Or is it the giraffe?
It is the giraffe!
Here is the fun fact. The giraffe is the tallest animal on land.
How tall? Look! A giraffe can peek into an upstairs window.
Its long neck helps it reach the leaves at the very top of the tree.
Even a baby giraffe is tall. On the day it is born, it is as tall as a grown-up!
And a giraffe's tongue is long too. As long as your arm!
Say it with me. The giraffe is the tallest!
Can you stretch up tall like a giraffe? Reach, reach, reach!
So tall!
Who is the biggest animal that walks on land?
Is it the elephant? Or is it the hippo?
It is the elephant!
Here is the fun fact. The elephant is the biggest animal on land.
How heavy is an elephant? As heavy as four cars! Count them with me.
One, two, three, four!
Big body, big ears, and a big, long trunk!
The trunk works like a hand and like a hose. It can pick up a tiny peanut, or spray a big shower!
Even a baby elephant is heavy. It weighs as much as a big grown-up on the day it is born.
Say it with me. The elephant is the biggest!
Can you stomp like a big elephant? Stomp, stomp, stomp!
What big stomps!
Who is the biggest cat in the whole world?
Is it the lion? Or is it the tiger?
It is the tiger!
Here is the fun fact. The tiger is the biggest cat of all.
Look at this little pet cat. The tiger is its giant cousin!
And guess what? Most cats do not like water. But tigers love to swim!
A tiger has soft, padded paws. So it can walk very, very quietly.
And every tiger has its own stripes, like a name tag.
Say it with me. The tiger is the biggest cat!
Can you show me your tiger paws? Paws up! Rawr!
What a great tiger!
Who has the loudest roar of all the big cats?
Is it the lion? Or is it the tiger?
It is the lion!
Here is the fun fact. You can hear a lion's roar from five miles away!
Five miles is a long, long way. Like the other side of town!
Why does a lion roar? To tell everyone, this is my home!
A lion's roar is almost as loud as thunder. Boom!
Lions live in a family called a pride. The roar helps the family find each other.
Say it with me. The lion has the loudest roar!
Can you roar like a lion? One, two, three. Roar!
What a mighty roar!
Wow! We met four animal champions. Now it is quiz time!
Get ready. Think hard!
Who can peek into an upstairs window?
The giraffe! Yes!
Who is as heavy as four cars?
The elephant! That's right!
Who is the giant cousin of a pet cat?
The tiger! Good job!
Whose roar can you hear from five miles away?
The lion! You remembered!
You learned four new things today.
Stretch like a giraffe. Stomp like an elephant. Paws up like a tiger. And roar like a lion!
Which champion is your favorite?
Thank you for learning with me. Bye-bye, friends! See you next time!
